SCHATVELD — Setup
=================
A treasure-hunting game on the real marshland of Weddewarden (Land Wursten),
Minecraft Java 1.21.10 (Fabric). Detect metal, dig it up, farm, and police the polder.

WHAT'S IN THIS ZIP
- schatveld-world-1.21.10.mrpack   the modpack (mods + datapack + resource pack) — EASIEST
- schatveld_datapack.zip           the game datapack (for manual / singleplayer setup)
- schatveld_resources.zip          the resource pack (3D models, item textures, 9 languages)
- schatveld-shaders-1.20.1.mrpack  optional shaders (Apple-Silicon-safe, MC 1.20.1)
- how-to-play.html                 how to play (open in any browser)

EASIEST SETUP (Modrinth App)
1. Install the Modrinth App:  https://modrinth.com/app
2. In the app:  + Add Instance  ->  From file  ->  choose  schatveld-world-1.21.10.mrpack
   (it downloads all the mods automatically).
3. Play the instance.
4. Create a NEW world with "Allow Cheats: ON".
5. Put the datapack in that world:
   Modrinth -> the instance -> Open folder -> saves -> <your world> -> datapacks
   -> paste  schatveld_datapack.zip  there.
6. Turn on the resource pack:  Options -> Resource Packs -> move "Schatveld" to Selected.

HOW TO PLAY (singleplayer)
- On first join you automatically get a METAL DETECTOR + SHOVEL, and the marsh builds
  around you.
- HOLD the detector: a meter at the top of the screen and a number 0-100 show how much
  metal is where you stand. Walk around to find a high reading.
- DIG the ground (with the shovel) on a good spot. The reward scales with the value:
      low  = iron nugget      average = iron ingot      high = GOLD if you're lucky
- Roles: type  /function schatveld:menu  and pick Archaeologist / Farmer / Police.
      Farmer gets a Tractor, Police a Police Car (right-click ground to drive, sneak to stop).
- Language: Options -> Language (English, Deutsch, Francais, Russian, ... 9 total).

SHADERS (optional, Apple Silicon Macs)
- Import  schatveld-shaders-1.20.1.mrpack  as a SEPARATE instance (MC 1.20.1 + Iris +
  Complementary Reimagined). These run on OpenGL 4.1; the 1.21 game world runs without Iris.

FULL VERSION (euro economy, museum collection, reputation ranks) — needs a small server
- Get the whole project:  https://github.com/molgang/schatveld
  then run in a terminal:  bash pybrain/play.sh   and connect Minecraft to  localhost .

Have fun digging the marsh!
